P19-22.name: Finishing Dance
P19-22.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Diva" family Spirit effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Type: Song]

[Flash]
Immediately end the battle. Then, by sending two cores from any of your "Producer" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, during this turn, an opposing Spirit can't attack.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5952.name: Kamen Rider Zero-One Flying Falcon
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5952.effect:
This symbol and reduction symbols of this card/Spirit are also treated as Red/Purple/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put one core from the Void to your Trash. Also, put one core from the Void to a "Kamen" family Spirit you control, other than this one.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
By paying three cost, refresh this Spirit.
